goal: Explain the health check contract and identify at most two concrete limitations supported by the supplied source.
context: Spooldesk is a multichannel helpdesk. This is a source review; no live service needs to be contacted.
constraints: Cite source lines. Do not claim to have executed tests.
acceptance_criteria: Name each health subsystem and its failure conditions.
delegation_reason: An independent review can identify a contract mismatch before the Lead relies on health checks for deployment.
context_cost_reason: Only one small module is needed; the whole repository and conversation are unnecessary.
